question: If it was Reinhard versus everyone else, would he still win anyways? Subaru couldn’t win, even if he had more powers than he could count?
answer: I’ve said it before, but if the entire world was against him, he’d admit defeat, though not due to a problem of fighting strength. (Note: Not really sure how to translate ‘イチオシの数の力’. It might be closer to ‘the perfect number of powers’, or something completely different.)
